action_mapping_summary.scope: One CPU evaluation of frozen old BC3 and the exact clipped teacher formula on existing archived observed inputs, including expert and student visited states.
action_mapping_summary.primary_error: Actual runtime clipping before the common action noise; raw unclipped policy errors also reported.
action_mapping_summary.quantile_definition: 95th/max of absolute component errors pooled across three axes and all samples; per-sample vector L2 is separate.
action_mapping_summary.clipping_definition: Fraction of raw teacher components strictly beyond the action limit and fraction of samples with any such component.
action_mapping_summary.boundary: Strong low-level IK and scripted pickup/return remain. The upstream goal tracks actual cup XY; observations directly expose delayed goal errors and feedforward. Equal easy-task success is not evidence of DAgger, OPD, ICL, or recovery learning.

limitations: Readback consistency is not an additional independent functional acceptance.
Raw native crossing records are verified arithmetically; saved10Hzstates cannot independently reconstructevery nativecrossing.
Missing artifacts remain missing, failed starts retained; no finalstate is inferred.
